_comment: Example `<repo_root>/.crustify/analysis/<dir>/<stem>/files.json` produced by `compose/files_manifest.py`. **Port-scope files only** - one entry per file in this stem-group that appears in `<target>/.crustify/scope.json.port`. Wrap-scope files are NOT enumerated; the whole-repo include graph lives in T1's `includes.csv` for any consumer needing it. Composer-emitted; no agent involvement. Values below show the stem-grouping convention: `ssl/statem/statem.c` and `ssl/statem/statem.h` share `analysis/ssl/statem/statem/files.json` because they have the same dir + stem.
_comment_partition: Files share a manifest dir per `path_partition.manifest_dir_for(file)` - stem-grouped. Same partition as syms.json and types.json sibling files. System / external files (CodeQL gives absolute paths) route under `analysis/system/`.
_comment_kind: Three values, mechanically classified. **source** - extension `.c` / `.cc` / `.cpp`. **impl_header** - extension `.h` / `.hpp` AND at least one of: (i) a function definition (body present) whose def_file matches this header per T1 `functions.csv`; (ii) a function-like macro defined in this header whose body contains a statement (presence of `;` or `{`, indicating statement form rather than pure-expression substitution). **decl_header** - extension `.h` / `.hpp` AND not impl_header. The classification is per-file and target-independent. `export_header` (header declaring functions defined in port-scope sources) is NOT carried here - it's a target-relative property derived on demand via inverted lookup against `<target>/.crustify/scope.json` + the syms manifest's `declared_in` lists.
_comment_includes: Flat list of `#include` targets as CodeQL emits them. Paths are repo-relative when the included file is inside the source root, absolute for system headers outside the source root (e.g. `/usr/include/string.h`). Multiple `#include` directives of the same header from the same source file collapse to a single entry. Conditional includes produce entries only for branches the extractor actually took during the traced build. Port vs wrap classification of each include is derived per-target by intersecting against `<target>/.crustify/scope.json.port` - an include in scope.json is a port-side edge, anything else is wrap-side.
